items: Set NEXT_PUBLIC_KB_API_URL for browser-safe public API calls
Set PINUYUMAYAN_KB_API_URL for server-side internal API calls
Set PINUYUMAYAN_MAIN_SITE_API_KEY and PINUYUMAYAN_HMAC_SECRET as deployment secrets
Set AI_PROVIDER=openai|kimi|mock; production must not use mock
Set OPENAI_API_KEY or KIMI_API_KEY only in server runtime
Do not expose PINUYUMAYAN_* secret vars through NEXT_PUBLIC_*
Enable HMAC + nonce on all internal KB calls
Block Beinan/Peinan archaeological terms from AI source packets and article evidence
Keep admin review routes protected by main-site auth/RBAC
Use source packets only as cited historical/cultural facts
Use user idea only as opinion/reflection, never as source fact
